notes:
Tablets, foldables and TVs: Home's rows (Favorites, channel tiles and the movie and show rows) fade out at an edge when there's more to scroll to, as Sports does. Sports' game tiles tint each half with its team's colour, as on phones.

The More menu and other pop-up panels slide up from the bottom, follow your finger when you drag the handle or pull the list down from its top, and either slide away or spring back when you let go.
